items.summary: For her debut Lagniappe Session, Maisy Owen turns to four songwriters who share her gift for making difficult things sound beautiful. From Rosa Lee Carson’s devastating “The Drinker’s Child,” written when Carson was just fourteen, to Townes Van Zandt’s “Snowin’ on Raton,” David Olney’s “Deeper Well,” and Amy Winehouse’s “What Is It About Men,” Owen follows a thread through country, folk and soul-pop songwriting, finding a sweetness in songs that are anything but sweet. The post The Lagniappe Sessions :: Maisy Owen first appeared on Aquarium Drunkard .

items.title: Julien Baker Debuts New Songs At Nashville Popup
items.summary: Julien Baker appears to be cooking something up . Five and a half years after the release of Little Oblivions , her last solo album, Baker is once again getting active outside the context of her many collaborations. Yesterday, after posting a few cryptic practice-space videos on a new Instagram , Baker announced a last-minute show in the Blue Room, part of Nashville's Third Man Records headquarters. She played that set last night, and she busted out some new songs. The post Julien Baker Debuts New Songs At Nashville Popup appeared first on Stereogum .
